MAILGUEST

Privacy Policy

How MailGuest handles your temporary inbox.

Updated November 14, 2026.

Mailbox data

Your tab stores the temporary address, provider session token, and estimated expiration in session storage. MailGuest requests inbox data directly from Guerrilla Mail and displays it in the browser.

Mail and hosting providers

Guerrilla Mail receives and processes incoming email, including message content and sender information. Your browser connects directly to its API, which receives ordinary connection information such as your IP address. The hosting platform may process request and sign-in information to serve the site and manage access. Guerrilla Mail

Removing an address

Removing or replacing an address clears or replaces its session in this tab. Guerrilla Mail controls retention and expiration of email on its servers. Keep sensitive or confidential messages in an inbox you control.

Questions

Use the reporting instructions on the Support page.
